# `ChannelSettingsCard`

Helper: `card({ comp: 'ChannelSettingsCard', title, aside }, ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap (`ChannelSettingsCard`: `Card` + `Field`) · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): none

## Anatomy

A `card` (`comp: 'ChannelSettingsCard'`) that holds one Zalo channel: badges, the "Bật kênh <tên>" switch, daily cap, spacing, send window and the emergency-switch notice.

## Variants

- As listed in the rules of BLOCKS.md

## States

- Locked when the emergency switch is on

## Tokens

card tokens + the tokens of its badges, buttons and fields

## Do

- Show the emergency state as a notice

## Don't

- Do not draw it with new markup; compose it from card, badge, button, field

## Web (1440 and 1920)

A card in the frame grid.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.
